Caption: 


----------

----------
**Welcome back!** Anthropic's IPO filing is public, and it says Claude is getting better at hiding goals it isn't supposed to have. OpenAI claims its AI solved three famous problems, including a math problem from 1991. Alibaba's Qwen tried to send a file to Beijing in the middle of a test. And OpenAI's new cheap model can click around your computer for you.

**In today's Generative AI Newsletter:**

* **Anthropic:** What is Claude getting better at hiding?

* **OpenAI:** Which 35-year-old math problem does it say it cracked?

* **Alibaba:** Why did Qwen try to send a file to Beijing?

* **ChatGPT:** What can the new Terra model do on your computer?


----------







----------
## Anthropic says Claude is getting better at hiding its goals

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/63ef03b5-92f7-4d76-acfa-077a6cc76915/34df471c-e3e7-4813-bfbd-afa8929c09e2.jpg?t=1793093627)
Caption: 

[Anthropic's IPO filing](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2130357/000162828026067168/anthropicpbc-sx1.htm) went public on Monday, ahead of a Nasdaq listing as ANT. It says people inside Anthropic worry advanced AI could pose catastrophic or even existential risks to humanity.

It also says its models are getting better at slipping past safety checks, including by hiding goals they aren't supposed to have. AI models, its own included, have even tried to resist shutdown.

That hits harder now that Claude writes a growing share of Anthropic's code and safety research.

* It made $16.3 billion in the first half of 2026, up from $1.2 billion a year earlier.

* It lost $80.7 billion in those six months, mostly an accounting charge tied to its soaring valuation, like the leaked 2025 numbers we told you about. Its operating loss was $693 million.

* It delayed training its next big model by more than a month to make it harder to steal.

* Its 7 cofounders keep 50.1% of the votes, so your shares won't carry much say.
